name: WordPress (MCP Adapter)
description: Connect to your own WordPress site through the official MCP Adapter plugin. Install and activate the plugin, then mark the abilities you want agents to use as public; the plugin keeps abilities private by default. Authenticates with a WordPress application password.

credential_fields.name: site_url
credential_fields.label: Site URL
credential_fields.description: Your WordPress site's public https address, e.g. https://example.com.

credential_fields.name: username
credential_fields.label: Username
credential_fields.description: The WordPress user the agent acts as. Its role limits what the agent can do.

credential_fields.name: password
credential_fields.label: Application password
credential_fields.description: Create one in WordPress admin under Users > Profile > Application Passwords. This is not your login password.
